text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — VendorRisk team wants an "access-control pack" for their SIG/CAIQ review. Needs: sample SAML assertion that maps to RBAC, an RBAC export (YAML), service-account rotation + revoke process, session TTLs, and one audit row proving MFA was honored for a hosted user. Deadline: tomorrow 10am PST.

vivian: I can own RBAC + rotation blurb. High-level: signing keys and service-account secrets are stored in customer or Redwood KMS depending on deployment. Defaults: service-account token TTL = 3600s, API token TTL = 900s (refresh allowed). For Dedicated we can issue mTLS client certs signed by Redwood CA. Rotation policy: automated nightly rotation for ephemeral signing keys, weekly rotation for root keys, immediate revoke via revocation API on compromise. Will include a short ops note.

samir: I'll take SAML + MFA. Short summary for SIG: Redwood accepts SAML 2.0 / OIDC, maps attributes (email/groups/entitlements) into RBAC rules, and records authn_context + mfa boolean in audit events. For Hosted customers we require MFA for org-admins by default; customers can enforce MFA at IdP for all users. Adding sample assertion below.

```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name=\"email\"><AttributeValue>${user.email}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"groups\"><AttributeValue>${user.groups}</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"entitlements\"><AttributeValue>redwood:deployer</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name=\"authnContext\"><AttributeValue>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:ac:classes:TimeSyncToken</AttributeValue></Attribute>
</AttributeStatement>
```

vivian: RBAC YAML sample (minimal, shows least-privilege scoping):

```
roles:
  - id: model-reader
    permissions: [models.read, logs.read]
  - id: deployment-runner
    permissions: [deployments.create, deployments.update]
service_accounts:
  - id: poc-runner-sa
    scopes: [models.read]
    token_ttl_seconds: 3600
    allow_pattern: "/v1/models/poc-*"
```

samir: To pull a proof row (org-admin):
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \"https://console.redwood/api/v1/audit?filter=event:authentication.success AND mfa:true&limit=1\"
```

devops-bot: audit-export created: /exports/vendorrisk/mfa_proof_1809990000.csv (presigned link active 72h)

vivian: Ops blurb for SIG/CAIQ (short): "Service account credentials are issued as short-lived tokens or mTLS certs and signed by KMS-managed keys. Keys are rotated automatically (nightly for ephemeral, weekly for root). Revocation is immediate via the revocation API and all rotation/revoke events are recorded in the audit log."

elaine: Great — can you also add a one-paragraph statement we can paste exactly into the questionnaire about delegation + MFA recording?

samir: Paste-ready sentence: "Redwood delegates primary authentication to customers' identity providers using SAML 2.0 or OIDC; MFA decisions are enforced at the IdP (or by tenant controls for Hosted) and the resulting authn_context and mfa=true flag are recorded in Redwood audit events, which are exportable for vendor risk reviews."

devops-bot: upload complete: /uploads/vendorrisk/access_control_pack_1809990000.zip (presigned link valid 72h)

elaine: Thank you all — I'll review the ZIP and send to VendorRisk. If they ask for KMS audit snippets we can follow up with a limited export.
